points.quote: It's split into a framework layer, a set of AFFiNE-specific packages ... **Framework (`blocksuite/framework/`)** This layer doesn't depend on AFFiNE's block types.
`std` is the standard editor runtime. It provides the view layer, the dependency-injection container, the extension mechanism, selection, commands and the gfx (canvas) base.

**`blocks/*`**: one package per block type ... **`widgets/*`**: UI overlays such as the toolbar, slash-menu, drag-handle ... **`fragments/*`**: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title ... The mode switch toggles page and edgeless modes.
The AFFiNE frontend picks which block, widget and fragment extensions to register, and it connects the editor to workspace storage and sync.
The app is wired in as workspace dependencies. `packages/frontend/core/package.json` depends on `@blocksuite/affine`, ...
